title: Attempt run status
description: The status.json at the root of every sealed evidence bundle: what benchctl attempted, how far it got, and how each subject exited. Written on every path including crash, timeout, and interrupt by the always-seal supervisor in crates/benchctl/src/seal.rs. Documentation mirror of the RunStatus serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/status.rs, which is the source of truth and pins the snake_case wire strings below.

experiment_id.description: 64-character lowercase hex identity of the resolved intent. Null when the attempt failed before resolution, which still seals a bundle.

execution_status.description: Worst-wins precedence: timed_out beats crashed beats partial beats complete. A complete run can still be invalid; validity is the separate kafkars.classification.v1 axis.

failure_reason.description: Why the status is not complete. Null for a complete run.

interrupted.description: True when SIGINT or SIGTERM reached benchctl; an interrupted run seals as partial.

subjects.description: One entry per subject, in execution order. A failing subject records evidence and the run continues; there is no fail-fast.

execution.description: Process exit facts. Null when the subject was never spawned, for example after an earlier phase failed.

signal.description: Terminating signal number when the child died from a signal.

adapter_outcome.description: outcome field of this subject's kafkars.adapter-status.v1 document. Null when the adapter wrote no status.

result_present.description: Whether a parseable result.json was found for this subject.

verification.description: Outcome of the configured verifier tool for this subject's measured and warmup topics. Null when verification was skipped.

phases.description: Phase records of the attempt state machine, in order. A skipped phase makes the run partial.
